memo: Prior-period error correction per ASC 250: opening 2200 of 65,000 (opening TB 12/31/2024) exceeds the supported contract liability of 41,000 (client note: Trestle prior contract Jun 2024-May 2025, 8,200/mo x 5 remaining months). The 24,000 difference has no contract behind it at 12/31/2024 - the Trestle renewal was ordered/signed 2025-01-01 (order form C-026), so no contract liability for it could exist earlier (ASC 606-10-25-1, 45-2). Restated opening balances: 2200 reduced 24,000, offset to opening retained earnings (3900). Disclosed in open_items.md.

January 2025 monthly subscription invoices INV-2201..INV-2224, 24 customers, total 30,450 (invoices.csv). SaaS access provided continuously over January; series satisfied over time (ASC 606-10-25-14(b), 25-27; policy #1).

INV-2225 Trestle Freight LLC renewal: 24,000 billed upfront for 12 months from service start 2025-01-01 (order form C-026). Billed in advance = contract liability, not revenue (ASC 606-10-45-2; policy #1: annual upfront billings to deferred, release 1/12 per month).

Customer cash receipts, 25 receipts totaling 54,450 (cash_receipts.csv), all applied to January invoices INV-2201..INV-2225. Every receipt matched one bank credit by date/amount/customer (bank 01/15 WIRE Trestle 24,000; ACH deposits 01/20-01/26 total 30,450). No receipt applied against opening A/R of 92,650 - flagged in open_items.md.
Gusto payroll processing fees 240 (vendor_bills.csv, category 'G&A other').
Payment of vendor bills JE-2501-004..008 by bank ACH 01/05-01/09: AWS 9,920 + WeWork 7,200 + Gusto fees 240 + Notion/Slack/GitHub 1,460 + Google Ads 3,250 = 22,070 (bank_statement.pdf).
January payroll per Gusto register (9 employees): gross 54,404; net paid 48,200 (bank 01/25 ACH GUSTO NET PAY); employee withholding 6,204 = 54,404 - 48,200 credited to 2210 payroll taxes payable.
Employer payroll taxes & benefits per register: 5,076, credited to 2210.

Tax remittance via Gusto (bank 01/25 ACH GUSTO TAX 11,280; register taxes_remitted 11,280) = employee withholding 6,204 + employer taxes 5,076 = 11,280. Payroll agrees to register and bank; 2210 cleared to zero.
Monthly depreciation per close checklist item 6: 1,777.78 (equipment 64,000 over 36 months = 1,777.78; opening accumulated 21,333 = 12 months x 1,777.78, consistent).

Revenue earned from deferred revenue: Trestle prior contract (Jun 2024-May 2025) release 8,200 (41,000 / 5 remaining months per client note); Trestle renewal 24,000 x 1/12 = 2,000 (policy #1). Total 10,200. Monthly invoices were billed and earned in the same month and are in JE-2501-001; no month-end contract liability arises for them.
